# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Weekly Review

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the UX and accessibility requirements, with users with ADHD as the design centre — one decision per screen, no shame copy, unsaved text, VoiceOver and keyboard. Tests whether these requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable; not whether an implementation works.
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [design.md](../design.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)
**Audience / depth**: PR reviewer · release gate

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
Use it to verify requirements clarity after `/speckit-plan`; it does not replace
the constitution, ADRs, the `/speckit-review` gate, tests, code review, CI, or
the landing and release gates.

**Ownership**: reviewer-owned. `[x]` means the requirements-quality criterion is
satisfied; it never means implementation work is done. At the reviewer's explicit
request, the items were evaluated by the agent against the artifacts as of
2026-10-06; every mark below is open to the reviewer's confirmation. Items marked
"Fixed" were plain gaps closed in the named artifact during this pass.
`/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is "one decision at a time" specified for every decision-bearing step, so it can be checked per screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, §US4-10]
- [x] CHK002 Are the banned shame signals enumerated (streaks, streak loss, red styling for age, the word "overdue"), so "shame-free" is checkable on every review surface, notification and widget included? [Completeness, Spec §US5-6, §FR-004, §FR-038; Contracts ios-commands §6 `ReviewCopy`]
- [x] CHK003 Are non-reproachful outcomes specified for every low-engagement path (completed without activity, restart after a gap, onboarded but never reviewed, "Not now", an all-zero summary)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, §FR-017, §FR-050, §FR-033; Design M-10, M-16, M-22]
- [x] CHK004 Does the unsaved-text requirement enumerate every free-text field of the feature, including the first next action typed for a project without one? [Gap, Spec §FR-052; Design M-08, M-19] — Fixed: FR-052 now names it; the draft keys in data-model E10 / E11 and contracts/ios-commands.md §7 cover a project.
- [x] CHK005 Are close / back / Escape / swipe / leave paths, the default choice ("Keep editing") and draft restore after an app kill or tab close all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-052; Design M-03, M-13, D-02, D-03]
- [x] CHK006 Are VoiceOver focus targets defined for screens that appear without a tap (M-26, M-09, M-10, M-11, M-12) and after each dismissal? [Completeness, Design "Keyboard and focus"]
- [x] CHK007 Are keyboard paths (tab order, focus traps, Escape order, number keys, the Undo shortcut, browser Back) defined for every web dialog and for the review route? [Completeness, Design "Keyboard and focus", D-02, D-03]
- [x] CHK008 Are Dynamic Type requirements defined beyond the decision card — the review step chrome and bottom bar, the summary counts grid, the explainer and While-you-were-away sheets, and the widget chip at accessibility sizes? [Gap, Design "Mobile viability"] — Resolved by owner decision 2026-10-06: every iOS screen up to AX5; content scrolls, the summary grid becomes one column, the step bar scrolls sideways, the widget chip may wrap with a 44 pt link area (design "Mobile viability" and M-22 "accessibility text size" with a new mockup frame; plan US4 and Test strategy; quickstart Scenario 5 step 12; tasks T133, T134, T137, T143, T155, T159, plus the AX5 entries in T092, T093, T094 and T116).
- [x] CHK009 Are contrast requirements stated for the new marker chips, the "Ageing" chip and the recommendation styling? [Gap, Design "Marker system"] — Fixed: design "Mobile viability" now requires WCAG 2.2 AA and records the measured pairs (7.1:1, 6.8:1, 6.9:1); no visual change.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is the Undo window quantified, including its accessibility extension (≥ 10 s under VoiceOver / Switch Control; the web timer pauses on focus or hover)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-048; Design "Undo (iOS)", "Undo toasts (web)"]
- [x] CHK011 Is "visually recommend without restricting choice" defined by a fixed reason → decision mapping and a non-colour cue ("Recommended")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007; Design M-03; Contracts ios-commands §6]
- [x] CHK012 Are markers required to carry text plus icon, never colour alone? [Clarity, Design "Marker system", "State communicated by color alone"]
- [x] CHK013 Are tap-target sizes quantified for markers, chips, Undo and the widget link (44 pt / 44 px)? [Clarity, Design "Mobile viability"]
- [x] CHK014 Are the mode time estimates (~5 / ~20 minutes) tied to a measurable criterion (active time, pauses excluded)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004; Data model §E3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Are Escape semantics consistent, and deliberately different only where stated (D-05 Escape counts as seen; While-you-were-away Escape does not acknowledge; Escape never closes the review)? [Consistency, Design D-01, D-05, "Keyboard and focus"]
- [x] CHK016 Are marker surfaces consistent between iOS and web (lists show only "asks" and "moves tomorrow"; "Ageing" only in M-02 / D-06)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004; Design "Marker system", D-06]
- [x] CHK017 Is the third-stall offer consistent across platforms, given that iOS has no thinking canvas? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005; Design M-03, D-02]
- [x] CHK018 Is the notification rule consistent with "no nagging" (at most one a week, no follow-ups, skipped after a counted review, none on the web)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036; Design M-25, D-01]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can the banned-term rule be verified automatically on both platforms (Vitest string and token guard; Core `ReviewCopy` and `MarkerStyle` tests)? [Measurability, Plan Test strategy]
- [x] CHK020 Are accessibility checks automated where possible (axe scans at desktop and 390 px) and recorded as labelled manual evidence where not (VoiceOver focus, Undo announcement, 44 pt targets)? [Measurability, Plan Test strategy]
- [x] CHK021 Is "one decision per screen" on the iOS app target given a verification path (manual evidence entry for FR-034)? [Measurability, Plan Test strategy manual row]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are overwhelm scenarios bounded by explicit offers (Inbox over 15 items, restart after 21+ days, Someday at most 7, "Not now" on a card)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030, §FR-017, §FR-032, §FR-050]
- [x] CHK023 Are interruptions (call, app kill, device switch, tab reload) defined for every review step, with a resume point? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029, Edge Cases "Interrupted review"; Design M-13]
- [x] CHK024 Are offline states defined for every iOS and web screen, including web controls that stay focusable while disabled? [Coverage, Design state inventory; Design D-01, D-06 offline rows]
- [x] CHK025 Is a narrow (390 px) web layout defined for every D- screen? [Coverage, Design "Mobile viability"]
- [x] CHK026 Is Reduce Motion behaviour specified (instant card transitions, no ambient animation)? [Coverage, Design "Mobile viability"]
- [x] CHK027 Is the first exposure specified so nothing moves before the person has seen a plain explanation with a concrete date? [Coverage, Spec §FR-051, §FR-016; Design M-26, D-05]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 Is the documented "Weekly review stays deferred" rule reconciled with the working entry? [Dependency, Design "Design authority"; Plan PR-01] — The plan schedules the design skill, its test and `docs/native-ios-app.md`; `ios/AGENTS.md` and `ios/README.md` carry the same rule and were added by tasks.md (T005, T158).
- [x] CHK029 Is the persona assumption (ADHD as the design centre, not positioned as "an ADHD app") reflected in the copy requirements? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions; Design copy columns]
